== Biography ==
William, possibly of Scotland, was previously listed as born 1667; the circa-1649 estimate depends on his being the correct father of the attached daughter. His death is estimated as 1725 in Henrico County, Virginia Colony, an area later known as Chesterfield County. These dates and places remain unsourced estimates.

== Research Notes ==
* Family records. This cannot be a source without definitive descriptive information. Chesterfield as a location did not exist until later. The area Chesterfield was formed out of Henrico County.
* His possible fatherhood of [[Mitchell-54795|Mary (Mitchell) Everitt]] remains unproved; her estimated birth is not an independently established basis for his birth year.
* An unproved comparison concerns CPT William Mitchell (circa 1667-1725), whose birth is reportedly Swift Creek, Henrico County. The different estimated birth dates alone do not exclude that identification. Thom King, "Family Tree King", [unsourced] database, Genealogy Online (https://www.genealogieonline.nl/family-tree-king/P1055.php : accessed July 4, 2026), "William Mitchell CPT (1667-1725)".

=== FamilySearch account comparison ===
[https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/details/P38N-T9P William Mitchell P38N-T9P] corresponds with medium confidence to the imported father hypothesis for [[Mitchell-54795|Mary (Mitchell) Everitt]]. Her explicit FamilySearch link, [https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/details/2H2Q-ZW3 2H2Q-ZW3], retains the same John Harrison household and five children, and names this William as father. This is an intended-account match, reviewed 15 November 2026, not proof of historical identity or paternity.<ref>Public historical WikiTree account, [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Mitchell-54795 Mary (Mitchell) Everitt, Mitchell-54795], family narrative and explicit FamilySearch link; retrieved 15 November 2026. FamilySearch, [https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/details/2H2Q-ZW3 2H2Q-ZW3] and [https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/details/P38N-T9P P38N-T9P], family and details pages freshly checked 15 November 2026. Tree-account provenance only; no independent record proves this father relationship.</ref>

The FamilySearch daughter is now a composite account headed Mary Hayward with displayed dates 1710-1782, incompatible with the earlier Harrison household. William's FamilySearch account has no sources and a garbled or circular parent family. The comparison does not endorse those ancestors, his spouse Mary Everett, the daughter's Hayward dates, a Scottish birthplace, a Henrico death or identification with the captain or the Edinburgh merchant. [https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/details/LR26-ZSX LR26-ZSX] remains an unproved alternative; no merge or relationship change is implied.

A possible identification concerns William Mitchell. The printed Edinburgh marriage register records Jean Glasgow with William Mitchell, merchant, on 16 December 1675.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 685 / 1/440 / 164; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record]; Henry Paton, ed., Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700 (Scottish Record Society, 1905), printed pp.267 and 481; PDF pp.277 and 491; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=491 record]; Same edition, unnumbered Prefatory Note, PDF p.9; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=9 record].</ref> The printed transcription and its preface were visually inspected on 30 September 2026; original parish image unchecked. The identification remains uncertain.
